subject.title: fix(agent): recover disconnected gateway runs before rerunning

question: Should `openclaw agent` change its default ambiguous-disconnect policy to recover the accepted Gateway run first, while retaining the current isolated embedded fallback only when recovery cannot establish an outcome?
rationale: This changes the established CLI failure contract, including response timing and the tradeoff between avoiding duplicate side effects and preserving an immediate locally rerun result; source review cannot safely choose that product behavior alone.

options.title: Approve recovery-first
options.body: Adopt wait-and-cache-only replay before the existing isolated automatic fallback, subject to final-head proof and protocol compatibility validation.

options.title: Keep recook-first
options.body: Retain the current automatic isolated fallback after uncertain disconnects and close or substantially narrow this branch.

options.title: Split by invocation mode
options.body: Define different behavior for delivery-oriented and interactive CLI runs only if maintainers want that additional permanent policy surface.

recommendation.title: Approve recovery-first
recommendation.body: Adopt wait-and-cache-only replay before the existing isolated automatic fallback, subject to final-head proof and protocol compatibility validation.

likelyOwner.reason: This person introduced the merged fresh-session fallback behavior whose user-facing contract the PR changes.
